category: Deep tech / Aerospace software / Mission engineering
one_line_description: AI-native mission computation layer for space, physics, aerospace, robotics, and engineering teams.
core_problem: Mission and physics calculations are fragmented across spreadsheets, scripts, simulation tools, legacy calculators, and tacit expert knowledge.
core_solution: One premium workspace for mission calculations, physics workflows, assumption tracking, trade studies, and decision-ready outputs.
differentiation: Mission computation operating layer—not a disposable calculator; traceability, scenarios, and brief-ready exports as first-class.

shipped_in_repo: Static early-access CTA form UI (placeholder submit)
roadmap_not_shipped: MVP calculators: orbital, mass, power, thermal, comms

website.tone: Premium dark aerospace, mission control, glass panels, cyan/slate/violet/emerald accents

product.engineering_truth: Interactive calculators and backend persistence are roadmap unless implemented in source.

technical_stack.animation: none by default; framer-motion optional if justified

preserve: Design direction and section order on the landing page unless intentionally rebranding
Product vs roadmap honesty in copy and README
do_not: Use npm or yarn for installs
Deploy with vercel --prod or push to GitHub without explicit founder approval
Invent customers, logos, NASA/defense partnerships, or certifications
Expose private founder details or credentials in repo or public copy
Replace the site with a generic SaaS template
Delete recovery or autobuilder files without archiving
autobuilder_strategy: Land the narrative and visual system first; ship calculators and APIs in small vertical slices with tests; keep RECOVERY_NOTES and JSON state updated after each milestone.
cleanup_policy: Ignore build artifacts and secrets via .gitignore; never delete source, configs, README, recovery notes, autobuilder files, or .env.example as part of cleanup.
last_recovery_summary: Greenfield Next.js 15 + TS + Tailwind v4 landing for TrajectoryOS with full required sections, lucide-react icons, client-only CTA placeholder, and autobuilder foundation files.
